summary: Focana 2.4.9 keeps your queued next steps visible and makes the handoff after a focus session more useful.
improvements: Completed sessions can now offer one short, sourced Focus Fact without interrupting active focus, pauses, or breaks.
Focus Facts support lightweight feedback and an explicit one-time option to email the related article without subscribing you to marketing.
Queued Up next tasks appear at the top of What's next and can be carried directly into the next task entry.
fixes: Queued tasks no longer disappear from What's next after the active task is marked complete.
Continuing a long paused Freeflow session as Timed starts the selected countdown instead of carrying the old count-up display forward.
Compact, full, and floating window transitions preserve the running timer and task context through repeated size changes.
